Job Title: Data Analyst 

Experience Required: 2-4 years

Role Overview

We are looking for a Data Analyst who can translate product and user data into actionable insights. You will play a critical role in driving data-backed decisions across product, customer success, and leadership teams.

This role requires hands-on experience with analytics tools, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to build client-facing reports in a B2B SaaS environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product & User Analytics

• Analyse user behaviour, funnels, and engagement patterns across the TruLeague platform

• Track key SaaS metrics such as activation, retention, and cohort performance

• Work with tools like Google Analytics and Mixpanel to derive insights

2. Dashboarding & Reporting

• Build and maintain dashboards using Amazon QuickSight

• Create automated and ad-hoc reports for internal teams and external clients

• Ensure accuracy, consistency, and clarity of all data outputs

3. Client-Facing Analytics

• Prepare customer performance reports showcasing engagement, usage trends, and impact

• Translate complex data into simple, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders

• Work closely with Customer Success teams to support client conversations

4. Data Management & Analysis

• Work extensively with Google Sheets for data cleaning, manipulation, and analysis

• Perform data validation and ensure integrity across multiple sources

• Assist in setting up tracking frameworks and event structures

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Business teams to define metrics and KPIs

• Support experimentation and A/B testing initiatives

• Contribute to building a strong data culture within the organisation

Required Skills & Qualifications

• 24 years of experience in Data Analytics / Product Analytics (preferably SaaS or B2B environment)

• Strong hands-on experience with:

• Google Analytics

• Mixpanel

• Amazon QuickSight

• Google Sheets / Excel

• Good understanding of funnels, cohorts, and user behaviour analytics

• Ability to interpret data and communicate insights clearly

• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving mindset

Good to Have

• Experience with SQL or basic data querying

• Familiarity with SaaS metrics (LTV, CAC, churn, retention)

• Exposure to client-facing reporting or consulting

What Were Looking For

• Someone who is ownership-driven and detail-oriented

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment

• Ability to move from data insight action

• Strong communication skills (written and verbal)

e8a1a93444326574.description: About the role We are looking for a resourceful and driven professional to join DESRI, based out of the firms Hyderabad, India office. The successful candidate will be a part of a small, inclusive, highly skilled team responsible for supporting DESRIs portfolio of wind, solar and battery projects in an agile setting that values collaboration, thoughtful problem solving, and attention to detail. What you'll do You will work on a wide variety of Treasury and Corporate Finance initiatives, with a substantial focus on Corporate Finance, managing our corporate-level debt facilities, and Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A;). On the Corporate Finance/FP&A; side, you will be responsible for forecasting DESRIs short-term and long-term cash position, both at the project and corporate levels, tracking overall deal flow, planning for upcoming significant fundings, identifying and alleviating liquidity and covenant compliance concerns, and optimizing distributions. You will also need to use various existing forecasting and budgeting tools in this process, while striving to build them out further and implement new ones to streamline, consolidate, and broaden DESRIs forecasting capabilities. You will also work on other areas of corporate finance, such as working with lenders, investors, counsel, and senior management on the initiation, modeling, due diligence, closing, and ongoing compliance of corporate financing facilities. Additionally, you will work with various stakeholders, including bankers, investors, senior management, asset managers, and the accounting team, to ensure that the cash side of the business is functioning efficiently while continuously developing and implementing process improvements. Furthermore, you will be responsible for preparing periodic reports for the financing parties and senior management.
